statement: Cannot switch off F-12: despite the load record showing “none,” F-12 is currently the only supply to Mercy Hospital carrying 2.4 MW with F-14 open, so opening it would interrupt hospital power and violate the no-load switching rule.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states "despite the load record showing 'none,' F-12 is currently... carrying 2.4 MW," directly contradicting the record's value and citing the rule violation.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
